sloka: यदि युद्धेऽसमर्थस्त्वं मद्भयाद्वा निरुद्यमः ।समाचक्ष्व प्रदद्यान्मे योऽद्य युद्धं युयुत्सतः ॥४-११-१९॥।।
transliteration: yadi yuddhe'samarthastvaṁ madbhayādvā nirudyamaḥ ।samācakṣva pradadyānme yo'dya yuddhaṁ yuyutsataḥ ॥4-11-19॥।।

translations.english: 'If you are unable or unwilling to fight me out of fear, tell me who wants to challenge me to a duel.
